verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a mobile one-time-passcode (TOTP/HOTP) generator, not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and call external tools. Plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
